name: Feature::Ui
guard: The game's descriptor registration `(u64* slot_out, texture_view*, user) -> bool`: takes the next free index of the shared descriptor pool, writes the view's descriptor there and stores the 8-byte slot. The UI texture update calls it with `(ui_texture + 0x40, view, 0)` and keeps the result at `+0x5c` (its destroy then releases the slot); the effect manager hands the same function to the particle system for every effect texture.

name: Feature::Ui
guard: The words that load the effect manager: `adrp x8, 0x5334000; ldr x8, [x8, #0x920]; ldr x0, [x8]` then `mov w1, #0x372; bl effect_load` (the game's own call `effect_load(*lib::Singleton<lib::EffectManager>::instance_, 0x372, &handle)`). The first two words name the slot `main+0x5334920` (`MANAGER_SLOT`), which the plugin decodes from them; the pointer in the slot points at the instance variable that holds the manager.

name: Feature::Ui
guard: In `effect_load` (`main+0x355fea0`): the manager's file entry is `manager + 0x18000 + slot * 0xa8` (`mov w11, #0xa8; madd`); the file's hash40 is stored at `+8` (`mov w12, #0x8008; movk w12, #1, lsl 16; str x10, [x11, x12]`) and the reference count at `+0x98` (`mov w10, #0x8098`...).

name: Feature::Ui
guard: In `effect_load`: the loaded file's address is stored at entry `+0x10` (`mov w9, #0x8010; movk w9, #1, lsl 16; str x11, [x8, x9]`) and its first four bytes are checked against `EFFN` (`cmp w8, #0x45` ...).

name: Feature::Ui
guard: In `effect_load`: the particle system is `[[manager + 0x193d8] + 0xf8]` (`mov w8, #0x93d8; movk w8, #1, lsl 16; add x9, x21, x8; str x9, [sp, #0x20]`, later `ldr x0, [x8, #0xf8]`), i.e. `[manager + 0x194d0]`; the `EFFN` header's block index is the short at `+0xe` (`ldrsh w8, [x11, #0xe]`).

name: Feature::Ui
guard: In `effect_load`, after the particle system made the resource: the entry's `+4` is its resource index (`mov w9, #0x8004; movk w9, #1, lsl 16; str w24, [x8, x9]`), and the resource is `[[system + 0x98] + index * 8]` (`ldr x8, [x8, #0xf8]; ldr x8, [x8, #0x98]; ldr x8, [x8, w24, uxtw #3]`), valid when its byte `+9` is set.

name: Feature::Ui
guard: In the particle system's texture section handler: the resource keeps the texture file object at `+0xa8` (`ldr x8, [x19, #0xa8]`), its texture count is the word at `[file + 0x38] + 4`, stored at resource `+0xa0`, and the textures are the pointers of the array at `file + 0x28` (`ldr x8, [x8, #0x28]; ldr x22, [x8, x21, lsl #3]`).

name: Feature::Ui
guard: In the resource's descriptor registration (`main+0x9ab70`, called with `main+0x35b9360` by the effect manager): for each texture it calls `register(&slot, [texture + 0x88] /* the texture view */, user)` and stores the 8-byte slot at `texture + 0x90` (`str x8, [x24, #0x90]`).

name: Feature::Ui
guard: In the same function: the resource's emitter sets are the table at `+0x58` (stride `0x38`; `+4` the emitter count, `+0x18` the emitter array), and each emitter (stride `0x3e0`) keeps the slots of its three samplers at `+0x48`, `+0x50` and `+0x58`.

name: Feature::Ui
guard: In the same function: the emitter's binary is the pointer at emitter `+0x10` (`ldur x8, [x20, #-0x38]`, with `x20` = emitter `+0x48`) and the three sampler texture ids are read from it at `+0x9f0`, `+0xa10` and `+0xa30`; the slot resolver `main+0x9acd0` stores the matching texture's slot into the emitter.
